run_lvis_clip_name: run the lvis_clip_name module to generate CLIP text embeddings for LVIS category names
run_lvis_clip_name_avg_synonyms: run the lvis_clip_name module with --avg_synonyms to average CLIP embeddings across category synonyms
run_lvis_clip_name_photo_prompt: run the lvis_clip_name module with --prompt photo to generate CLIP embeddings using 'a photo of a' prompts
run_lvis_clip_name_wn_name: run the lvis_clip_name module with --use_wn_name to derive synonyms from WordNet synsets
run_lvis_clip_name_map_name: run the lvis_clip_name module with --map_name to normalize category names by lowercasing and stripping parentheses
